title: Linux_XorDDoS_Botnet_Investigation_0b9
description: Investigate a compromised network with unusual traffic patterns, identify botnet components, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns, and initial investigations suggest a potential botnet infection. Your task is to investigate the compromised hosts, identify the botnet components, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Get Access

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that communicates with an external host?
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for unusual or recently created services. The suspicious service is named `bot-beacon`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for unusual or recently created services.

levels.title: Determine Command-and-Control Server
levels.content:
Determine the external host communicating with the compromised system.

**Question:** What is the IP address of the command-and-control server?
levels.solution: Investigate the network connections and logs of the suspicious service identified in the previous task. The command-and-control server's IP address is `192.168.70.5`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the network connections and logs of the suspicious service identified in the previous task.

levels.title: Identify Malicious Network Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service generating the malicious network traffic?
levels.solution: Look for services that are not part of the standard system configuration and check their execution logs. The service generating the malicious network traffic is named `bot-flood`.
